title: Evaluation Kit Evidence Artifact Reference
description: Identity and optional storage location for an Evaluation Kit evidence archive. Artifact identity is the content digest; location is transport metadata only and must never replace checksum verification.

artifactSchemaVersion.description: Evidence-artifact reference document shape. Independent of Maven software version and of corpus/result schema versions.

artifactId.description: Stable logical identity for this evidence package. Not a filesystem path and not a mutable URL.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact archived bytes (for example the .tar.gz payload). Canonical content identity.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte length of the archived payload identified by sha256.

mediaType.description: Optional IANA media type of the archived payload (for example application/gzip).

disclosure.description: public = project may redistribute; private = organization-controlled; external-reference-only = project does not rehost bytes (licensing or ownership).

recoveryMode.description: retrieve-only for historical/external bytes; regenerate-and-verify when deterministic generation can recreate bytes; retrieve-or-regenerate when either path is acceptable.

location.description: Optional storage locator. Absent when bytes are Git-resident, supplied out-of-band, or must remain private. Location is not artifact identity.

relatedIdentities.description: Optional bindings to Evaluation Kit identities. Transport metadata must not become detector provenance.

relativePortablePath.description: Relative portable path: no absolute roots, no '..' segments, no backslashes.

tag.description: Evidence checkpoint tag. Must not be a mutable alias such as latest/main/master (enforced by contract invariants). Distinct from software SemVer release tags unless intentionally aligned.

url.description: HTTPS object URL without embedded credentials (no userinfo). URL is a locator only; sha256 remains the identity.
